notes.not_the_same_as: a host/plain `cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm` or the R3e-deployed f5074235... build: different toolchain (1.96.0 vs 1.97.1) so different bytes are expected (not measured); compare the deployed code_hash against THIS record only
notes.cargo_near_note: `cargo near build reproducible-wasm` itself needs a git remote and a clean pushed tree (this repo has no remote); the script runs the same container command from `git archive` instead. The contract embeds no NEP-330 metadata, so the bytes do not depend on the NEP-330 env cargo-near passes.
notes.emulation: colima rosetta profile (docker-run-1 3m22s, run-2 3m24s). run-1 succeeded first time. The next two attempts (one run, one cp) exited rc=1 with stderr discarded (cause not captured; possibly the RR4 emulation flake) and were re-run unchanged, then succeeded with identical hashes.
